description: This file implements the cu_up_connection_manager class and related classes for managing CU-UP connections, message handling, and connection lifecycle in a telecommunications system, including connection setup, message forwarding, and shutdown procedures.

classes.name: cu_up_connection_manager::shared_cu_up_connection_context
classes.description: Holds shared context for a CU-UP connection, including connection state and message handling.

classes.name: cu_up_connection_manager::e1_gw_to_cu_cp_pdu_adapter
classes.description: Thread-safe notifier forwarding E1AP messages from E1 GW to CU-CP.

classes.name: cu_up_connection_manager
classes.description: Manages CU-UP connections, message forwarding, and lifecycle events.

methods.name: connect_cu_up
methods.description: Associates a CU-UP index with the connection context and retrieves its message handler.

methods.name: connected
methods.description: Checks if the CU-UP connection is active.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Removes the CU-UP connection and notifies the parent.

methods.name: handle_message
methods.description: Handles incoming E1AP messages from CU-UP.

methods.name: e1_gw_to_cu_cp_pdu_adapter
methods.description: Constructor for the message adapter, increments connection count.

methods.name: on_new_message
methods.description: Dispatches received messages to CU-CP executor.

methods.name: cu_up_connection_manager
methods.description: Constructor initializing connection manager with parameters.

methods.name: handle_new_cu_up_connection
methods.description: Handles new CU-UP connection requests, creates and attaches CU-UP processors.

methods.name: handle_e1_gw_connection_closed
methods.description: Handles cleanup when a CU-UP connection is closed.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Gracefully shuts down all CU-UP connections and stops the manager.
